subject: Update clang tidy/format github job and apply formatting (#321)
reason: The change is a CI workflow update plus a repository-wide clang-format application. Every hunk in src/ and vmsdk/ is mechanical reformatting: line re-wrapping, indentation and brace placement, include reordering within the same translation unit, comment re-flow, and namespace closing comments; no string literal, command flag, control flow or logic changes. The only functional edits are to .github/workflows/clang_tidy_format.yml (base-branch detection, clang-tidy temporarily disabled), which does not ship in the module. There is no runtime behaviour change to reach, so no scenario is warranted.
